description: This Dart source file defines utility functions for exporting quiz attempt analytics data in CSV and JSON formats. It provides two main functions: `analyticsToCsv` for generating CSV data and `analyticsToJson` for JSON-formatted output. The functions process quiz attempt data, KPIs, and per-quiz metadata, exporting the data for external analysis or reporting.

methods.name: analyticsToCsv
methods.description: Converts a list of quiz attempts, KPIs, and per-quiz metadata into a CSV-formatted string suitable for exporting or reporting.

methods.name: analyticsToJson
methods.description: Converts a list of quiz attempts, KPIs, and per-quiz metadata into a pretty-printed JSON string for data interchange or storage.
